verdict.rationale: The evidence shows several ways to intervene in a live session without restarting. You can jump in to help Devin through the Interactive Browser, take over in Devin's IDE after a first draft, work interactively in Devin for Terminal, and switch models mid-session with /model. MCP also exposes session management to other agents. None of it explicitly documents sending a follow-up chat message to steer a running session, so steering is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of mid-session follow-up messaging (web, Slack thread or API), details on how Devin incorporates new instructions while working, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
